notes: Twenty-one source and twenty-seven target tokens partitioned exactly once, in twenty-two units.
The italic that (t011) is added: the Hebrew clause has no conjunction, and rule 55 forbids folding it into הִנֵּה or the verb.
אֶרֶץ הַמֶּרְחָק is rendered a far country, so the rectum's article is unrepresented under rule 29's last sentence and the rectum itself goes attributively under rule 28.
